Uniform remote diagonal congruence yields a Toeplitz matrix in operator norm using an exponentially summable majorant. The closed symbol has sign governed precisely by cos(theta)>t. A self-contained banded-circulant approximation and interlacing prove both proportions. Compactness and infinite inertia follow from Hilbert–Schmidt trace-ideal factorization and min-max. Standalone checker passed 51 finite assertions but was not substituted for the proof.
